== Ingredients ==

* 2 slabs St. Louis style/cut [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] spareribs
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Barbecue Rub|Barbecue Rub]]
* Dry hickory chunks
* ¼ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] [[Cookbook:Soy Sauce|soy sauce]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Hoisin Sauce|hoisin sauce]]
* ½ cup [[Cookbook:Sake|sake]]
* 3 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Honey|honey]]
* 1 tbsp [[Cookbook:Mirin|mirin]]

== Procedure ==
#Peel off the thin membrane on each rib. Season ribs with the barbecue rub and refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
#Place hickory chunks in the firebox of a 250°F (120°C) [[Cookbook:Smoker|smoker]].
#Combine remaining ingredients in a large sauce pan over high heat and bring to a [[Cookbook:Boiling|boil]]. Cook, stirring occasionally, for 5 minutes or until slightly thickened. Set aside.
#Place ribs in smoker and cook for 5–6 hours, brushing with soy mixture often.
#Brush meat sides generously with soy mixture and place under a preheated [[Cookbook:Broiler|broiler]] until deeply browned. Watch carefully or it will burn!
# Slice into 1-rib portions and serve.
